name: cruise
setup: const c=window.cosmodoro; c.F.started=true; c.F.speed=0; c.F.elapsed=c.F.total*0.3; c.F.clock=200; document.getElementById('countdown').classList.add('off');

name: system
setup: const c=window.cosmodoro; c.F.started=true; c.F.speed=0; c.F.elapsed=c.F.total*0.5; c.F.clock=200; c.setView('system'); c.F.m=1;

name: switch_50
setup: const c=window.cosmodoro; c.F.started=true; c.F.speed=0; c.F.elapsed=c.F.total*0.43; c.F.clock=200; c.setView('system'); (function pin(){ c.F.m=0.5; requestAnimationFrame(pin); })();
